name: InvisiProxy LTS
postCreateCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate && pnpm install && curl -sLO https://github.com/theogbob/finalwisp/releases/download/v1.5.0/finalwisp-v1.5.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz && curl -sLO https://github.com/theogbob/finalwisp/releases/download/v1.5.0/SHA256SUMS && tar -xzf finalwisp-v1.5.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS && sudo install -m 0755 finalwisp-v1.5.0-x86_64-linux/finalwisp /usr/local/bin/finalwisp
